Levels.facedetection: Face detection task: whole scene visible, 6 s limit.
Levels.movingwindow: Moving-window task: only a gaze-contingent aperture around fixation visible, 20 s limit.

model.Description: Predictivity the deltas are computed from.

Levels.unique: Unique predictivity (the nine predictors of the full model).

Levels.Face expectation: preview - no preview: delta(face expectation): noise-corrected predictivity of face expectation in the preview minus the no-preview condition.
Levels.Mean of other features: preview - no pre: Mean delta of the other predictors in the model.
Levels.Contrast: face expectation - mean of oth: delta(face expectation) minus the mean delta of the other predictors.

estimate.Description: Observed value of the statistic, from derivatives/encoding/<task>_contrast.npz.

ci95_low.Description: Lower bound of the 95% bootstrap CI of estimate: 1000 resamples of images with replacement, the whole cross-validation rerun with copies of an image kept in the same fold; 2.5th percentile.

ci95_high.Description: Upper bound of the 95% bootstrap CI of estimate: 1000 resamples of images with replacement, the whole cross-validation rerun with copies of an image kept in the same fold; 97.5th percentile.

p_one_sided.Description: One-sided permutation p from run_contrast_test.py, in the predicted direction: greater than zero for the face expectation delta and the contrast, less than zero for the mean delta of the other features.
